items.exact_prompt:
Website hero image, wide landscape 3:2 (render at the largest landscape size available, e.g. 1536x1024). Golden-hour establishing view of Ward, a surviving oasis city built in a natural desert depression on Tir. Terraced sandstone ashlar buildings with recessed doorways, salvaged metal canopies, patched cloth awnings and balconies step up a hill crowned by one huge ancient oasis tree with a stone ring bed. Hydroponic greenhouses glow softly green, street-food stalls and small figures of people in desert workwear, a repurposed mining droid hauling crates, Warden watchtowers and defensive stone berms on the rim, half-buried colossal pre-Fall industrial structures and a dormant ring-shaped Quantum Tube node gate on the far edge, layered desert dunes and mesas to the horizon under a vast hazy sky. Composition: focal city and tree on the RIGHT two-thirds; the LEFT third is calmer sky and soft distant dunes as a text-safe area for a headline. Strong foreground/midground/background depth.
